provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
story: 405 km from Kolochava to Kolochava, about 6 h 59 of riding. It goes by way of Gorgany, Chornohora, Wooden Churches of Maramureş and Groșii Țibleșului - Izvorul Șurii. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from Ukraine into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
